title: DisallowCompanion - Actor
content:
Member of: Actor Script Tells this actor it is no longer allowed to be a companion (dismissing if they are a companion). Syntax: Function DisallowCompanion(bool SuppressDismissMessage = false) Parameters: - SuppressDismissMessage: Whether to suppress this dismissal message Default: False Return Value: None Examples: ; Prevent dogmeat from being a companion Dogmeat.DisallowCompanion()
; Prevent Curie from being a companion, but don't show dismiss message Curie.DisallowCompanion(true) See Also: - Actor Script - AllowCompanion - Actor - SetAvailableToBeCompanion - Actor - SetCompanion - Actor
